formula: ongoing total = R + S. R (each agro release) = F + P + D + B: F files the release bump touches, P pool-build fixture entries the release changes, D pool cells the release drains, B pool cell rebuilds or archive builds the release forces. S (each added spec) = C + K + Q: C pool cells the spec adds, K pool config blocks added across config.yaml, deploy/config.yaml, console-config.json, Q shared spec sites (NODE_SPECS, provider-catalog offering). N-prime: R=11+2+10+10=33, S=2+9+2=13, total 46. H: R=11+0+0+1=12, S=1+6+2=9, total 21. E4 favors H (21 < 46).
